items.stem: An internal agent will handle sensitive HR data. Which authentication choice is inappropriate?

options.text: No authentication, which lets anyone with the link chat with it

Manual authentication is a valid way to keep auth on other channels.

options.text: Restrict the agent to authenticated users
options.rationale: Restricting to authenticated users is appropriate here.
